characterdesc-blacksmith:
Each blow of your hammer breathes life into metal. Work the forge and bring forth tools of creation and ruin.

Blacksmiths are masters of metallurgy. Years of forgework has strengthened their swing, and they know how to maintain their equipment. Those skilled in the ways of the forge also tend to develop an eye for quality ore.
characterdesc-forester:
The forest's symphony is a dirge. Someday, even the greatest oak will fall.

Foresters are adept foragers. Skin of hardwood and sap in their veins, living off the land has taught them to make the most out of what nature provides.
traitdesc-woodcarver: Exclusive recipes to craft sticks from firewood

dialogue-tobias-blacksmith: (Blacksmith) You were a blacksmith. While we recycled what we could, we needed new parts for the machinery, and your lot delivered. Thinking back, you were one of the pillars holding us together; a group can only do so much without serviceable weaponry, tools, and parts.
dialogue-tobias-forester: (Forester) You were a forester. Wood is invaluable, even if abundant. Fuel for the fires, material for carpentry, handles for tools. Even while the Rot ravaged nature, you fought tooth and nail to conserve what you could and haul back timber to keep us warm and fed.
